privacy.metaDescription: How Menuyukti collects, uses, and protects data in your workspace.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

data.title: Data we process
data.body: Menuyukti processes information you provide when you use the service—including account details, location and sales data you upload, workspace content, and usage needed to run the service. We process this data to deliver analytics and AI-assisted features you request.

salesUploads.title: Sales report uploads
salesUploads.body: When you upload a sales Excel file, we extract the transaction data and store it in our database in Frankfurt (EU). We do not keep the original spreadsheet file.

use.title: How we use your data
use.body: We use your data to operate and improve the platform, provide support, secure accounts, and comply with law. We do not sell your personal information or your restaurant sales data to third parties for their marketing.

sharing.title: Service providers
sharing.body: We may use trusted subprocessors (for example hosting, authentication, and AI inference) that process data under contract and only as needed to provide the service. A current list can be provided on request.

security.title: Security
security.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure; we encourage strong passwords and safe sharing of workspace access.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: Menuyukti uses Google Analytics 4 for basic usage measurement (page views) on public pages and the signed-in workspace so we can understand how the service is used. The print shop is not included. You can review or dismiss the cookie notice via the Cookie settings link in the footer.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: The data controller is Daniel Dihardja, identified in the Imprint. For privacy-related questions or requests, use the contact details on the Imprint page.

terms.metaDescription: Terms governing access to and use of the Menuyukti platform.
terms.title: Terms of Service

service.title: The platform
service.body: Clients receive access to the Menuyukti platform—a workspace with AI solutions for hospitality, including analytics, AI-assisted features, inventory, and guest digital experiences. Access may include reusable modules with venue-specific configuration. Platform features and scope may change as the offering evolves.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Access to the platform requires an account. You are responsible for activity under your account and for keeping credentials secure. You agree to provide accurate information and to use the platform in compliance with applicable law.

acceptable.title: Acceptable use
acceptable.body: You may not misuse the platform, attempt to access others’ data without permission, interfere with operation of the platform, or use the platform to violate law or third-party rights.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: The platform and any AI-generated outputs are provided on an “as is” basis. Analytics and suggestions in the platform are informational; you remain responsible for business and compliance decisions.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms or the platform. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms where permitted by law.

impressum.metaDescription: Legal notice and provider identification for Menuyukti.
impressum.title: Imprint
